text:
alex: Quick proposal — introduce a `deferred-eval` feature flag for routing changes that waits for a short telemetry window before activating quota-driven shard moves. Rationale: avoid immediate capacity churn and bad cache/kv side effects when flipping routing policies.
maria: tl;dr? how long is the window and what telemetry are we gating on?
alex: High level: flag has three phases: dryrun (decisions recorded), observe (monitor metrics), enforce (apply routing). Default observe window 30m but configurable per-flag. Gate metrics: p95 latency, error rate, shard request skew, and cost-per-token delta. We need dashboard + automated gating.
jamal: concern: even in dryrun we might still perturb runtime if we let candidate routes prime caches or write KV. Dryrun must be pure read-only dryrun: log decisions but do not change cache or commit route state.
liz: +1 with jamal. Also need a simple rollback action in console and a circuit-breaker that auto-rolls back if p95 increases > 20% or error_rate > 0.5% for X minutes.
alex: proto config snippet for discussion:
```json
{
  "flag": "deferred_eval.routing_shard_move_v1",
  "mode": "dryrun->observe->enforce",
  "observe_window_minutes": 30,
  "gates": [
    {"metric":"p95_latency_ms","threshold":50,"direction":"lt"},
    {"metric":"error_rate_pct","threshold":0.5,"direction":"lt"}
  ],
  "rollback_on_failure": true,
  "notify": ["#eng-platform","oncall"]
}
```
maria: Dashboard needs: candidate vs enforce overlay, gating panel showing pass/fail per gate + 1h trend, and a histogram for shard request skew. Also a small panel for estimated cost delta from the sample.
ops-bot: Alert rule created: `deferred-eval-gate-fail` severity=warning when any gate fails for 3 consecutive 5m buckets.
jamal: RBAC question: who can promote observe->enforce? I propose: devs can start dryrun, platform leads + SRE can promote, SRE can emergency-rollback/enforce. Everything must be audited.
liz: UX: console should show an "expected user impact" estimate based on sampling (tokens/sec delta, p95 delta, cost delta). Make it clear when estimates are low confidence.
alex: Also want targeted canaries: e.g., only route 5% of enterprise traffic or targeted shards for specific customer classes.
maria: When we do targeted canaries, gates must be normalized per-customer-class (enterprise vs freemium) — otherwise an enterprise spike will mask freemium regressions.
deploy-bot: deploy started for config-service @ 1749876580 :gear: (dryrun support)
jamal: integration tests: please add a `--dryrun-sim` mode so the runtime simulates decisions without touching caches, and add a stress test so observe window state survives node restarts (or gracefully recovers).
alex: Action items: I'll open a PR with schema + console mocks + unit tests that simulate KV ripple. Requesting reviewers: @maria, @jamal, @liz. I'll also add the admin "abort-all-candidates" button for SREs that emits an audit event.
maria: +1 on schema and console mocks. Add the gating pass/fail history to exports so we can tie to postmortems.
liz: One more: add a one-click "pause all promotions" semaphore for incident windows.
alex: Good call — I'll include that. Thanks all.
